issues.reason: Coordination & plurals makes a coordinated NP distributive by default — replicate the whole predication once per conjunct, verbal to one event each — and reserves the one-event/many-role form for reciprocal or aggregate predicates, which 'list' is not, so filling one event's Theme slot twice violates a stated rule.

gaps_confirmed: a counted / indefinite capitalized plural kind-word label ('A few Keepers'): the capitalized-common-noun default is declared singular-collective only, and the plural carve-out covers only a label referring as a name, so neither branch decides a quantified capitalized plural
defect_summary: The relative clause should replicate per conjunct — two per-keeper listing events, (Member (sk_lista $x) list) (Agent (sk_lista $x) (sk_notebook $x)) (Theme (sk_lista $x) moth_count) and a parallel sk_listb event with weather_note — rather than one list event carrying two Theme atoms.
notes: Everything else holds: the stative-transitive 'lists' correctly takes Agent on the notebook (the 'manifest lists two pallets' precedent), the dependent existentials are proper Skolem functions of $x, 'a few' correctly takes CardinalityPhrase rather than a proportion strength, and both compound genera withhold the noun-modifier genus.
